questions.q: What made the pirates notice that the Doctor was escaping?
choices: Jip barked at the pirates
The anchor chain rattled
Dab-Dab quacked in alarm
Gub-Gub sneezed very loudly

questions.q: What did Ben Ali call himself?
choices: The Red Sea Wolf
The King of the Sands
The Barbary Dragon
The Terror of Barbary

questions.q: What did Ben Ali say he wanted from the Doctor before letting him go home?
choices: His whole ship and all its sails and ropes
A trunk-full of gold sent by his friends
The Doctor's medicine-bag and all his bottles
A promise to cure the pirates when they were sick
questions.evidence: you must make your friends send me a trunk-full of gold

questions.q: Why did Too-Too tell the Doctor to keep Ben Ali talking?
choices: So the old ship would sink under the pirates
So the swallows could come back and help them
So Jip would have time to swim to the shore
So the canaries could fly off to find the sharks
questions.evidence: Be pleasant, till the ship sinks under him

questions.q: Why did the Doctor say they should not fight the pirates?
choices: The pirates were far too many to fight
The animals were too tired from the island
Fighting was against the law of the sea
The pirates had pistols and swords
questions.evidence: But they have pistols and swords

questions.q: Why did Jip laugh at the pirate who said they would see rats leaving if the boat were sinking?
choices: Jip had chased all the rats off the ship
There had never been any rats on that ship
The rats had already left two hours before
The rats were hiding inside the pirates' boots

questions.q: What happened right after the ship sank to the bottom of the bay?
choices: The Doctor sailed away into the open sea
The six pirates were left bobbing in the water
The swallows came to pull the ship again
Ben Ali climbed onto the Doctor's ship
questions.evidence: the six bad men were left bobbing about in the deep water of the bay

questions.q: What did the shark offer to do for the Doctor?
choices: Eat up the pirates
Pull the ship home
Find the lost rats
Guard the canaries
questions.evidence: we will gladly eat them up for you

questions.q: Ben Ali "groaned in disgust" when told to grow bird-seed. What does "disgust" mean here?
choices: A feeling of being very cold and wet
A sudden fright that makes you shake
A happy surprise that makes you laugh
A strong feeling of dislike for something

questions.q: What is the most important thing the Doctor does with Ben Ali in this chapter?
choices: Lets the sharks eat him so the seas are safe for all ships
Takes him prisoner and carries him back home to Puddleby
Makes him promise to stop being a pirate and become a farmer
Teaches him to talk with the canaries and the sharks
questions.evidence: you must give up being a pirate altogether
